capabilityIndex.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

capabilityIndex.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: One simulation round.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

capabilityIndex.function: Allow one simulation round to pass at the current position.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: One simulation round; metabolism continues.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: No automatic energy recovery.

capabilityIndex.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: 1 + 0.2 times transferred mass energy.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack.

capabilityIndex.function: Consume an owned edible resource.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: Consumed food and 1 energy.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

capabilityIndex.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

capabilityIndex.function: Place owned units on the ground.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: 0.5 energy and transferred units.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack.

capabilityIndex.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: 0.5 energy and transferred units.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred.

capabilityIndex.function: Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: One simulation round.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Delivered after the round barrier; recipient text is data, not authority.

capabilityIndex.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

capabilityIndex.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

request.name: Inspect and page personal inventory
request.function: Provide a read-only, paginated inspection of my actual carried inventory so I can select exact existing item IDs for processing and distinguish intact branches, peeled cores, bark, food and tools.
request.conditions: At tick 96 my inventory display shows five stacks and omits four. I have gathered three branches, but their exact current stack ID is not visible. Processing contracts require actual input identities; I should not invent them or assume sufficient tray materials.
request.inputs: My own actual carried inventory only; support page selection or an exact item ID. Show quantities, resource IDs and already observable processing state without revealing unknown material properties.
request.costs: Read-only inspection effort as appropriate; no material creation, transfer or processing.
request.effects: Return existing personal stack identities and quantities with pagination so omitted stacks can be selected reliably. Do not grant mastery, discoveries, satisfaction or hidden-world access.

Shared references: actorId is bound to the authenticated living caller; itemId resolves an exact existing item, never a resource alias. Read only actual carried inventory owned by that actor, excluding ground items and other actors' holdings. Dependencies: authoritative inventory/ownership state, existing observable-property filtering, action scheduling and personal-result rendering; no material or tool prerequisites. Execution costs one round and 0.2 energy, with normal metabolism; insufficient energy fails without a debit. At execution completion, atomically validate and read current state, sorting by stable item ID. Return {inventoryRevision,page,pageSize,totalItems,totalPages,hasPrevious,hasNext,items}; each item includes exact id, resource, quantity, represented quantityTenths when present, and already observable processing form and availability/reservation status. Item mode returns only the matching carried item or a non-disclosing unavailable result. Never expose concealed composition or infer tool suitability, intactness or usable surface area beyond represented observable state. Revision changes between page requests are explicitly flagged so callers can restart; do not fabricate stable historical holdings. No inputs are escrowed, transferred, consumed, combined or locked. This is a single-round operation with no partial output or remaining work after completion; interruption or death before completion cancels the pending read without modifying inventory or emitting a successful result. No continuing effects, maintenance, new objects, collision changes or spatial reach requirement: this is inspection of one's own carried possessions. Declare inventory-inspected for completed results and inventory-inspection-stopped for cancellation, carrying actor/interface, request parameters, revision and success status; personal result payloads remain private. Bind the complete bounded page or item result to the action result, personal inspection panel and replay, with explicit pagination controls and omission counts; do not pass it through the truncating default inventory summary. Replays display the recorded execution-time result rather than querying later state. Migration adds the interface and presentation adapter without rewriting item IDs, provenance, ownership, quantities or prior records. Reuse inventory access and rendering code where available, separately from registering this new function.
